predictions.explanation: The prediction specifies a timeframe of **5–10 years** from the podcast date (September 27, 2025) for widespread deployment of robots that run their core AI inference locally on-device. As of today (November 30, 2025), only about **2 months** have passed since the prediction was made. This is far too early within the stated 5–10 year window to determine whether the typical robot in commercial use will predominantly rely on local inference rather than cloud-based inference. Therefore, the correctness of this prediction cannot yet be evaluated.

predictions.explanation:
Governor Gavin Newsom **did not sign** SB 771 into law; he **vetoed** it.

Multiple sources report that:

- On **October 13, 2025**, Newsom vetoed SB 771, a bill that would have fined social-media companies up to $1 million per post for algorithmically amplifying certain violent or hate-related content, calling the legislation “premature” and stating, “For this reason, I cannot sign this bill.” ([politico.com](https://www.politico.com/news/2025/10/13/newsom-siding-with-tech-giants-vetoes-online-hate-speech-bill-00606600?utm_source=openai))
- Civil-rights organizations such as CAIR-CA explicitly “welcomed Governor Newsom’s veto of SB 771,” confirming that his action on the bill was a veto rather than a signature. ([ca.cair.com](https://ca.cair.com/press-release/cair-ca-welcomes-governor-newsoms-veto-of-sb-771-commitment-to-protecting-free-speech/?utm_source=openai))

Because the prediction was that Newsom **would sign** SB 771 instead of vetoing it, and he **in fact vetoed** the bill, the prediction is **wrong**.

predictions.grok_explanation: The prediction deadline is September 27, 2030, but the current date is December 1, 2025—only ~2 months after the podcast. No evidence of a 'robot revolution' with widespread deployment materially boosting electricity demand. Tesla Optimus plans target thousands of units in 2025 (e.g., [Tesla announcements](https://humanoidroboticstechnology.com/industry-news/tesla-announces-ambitious-production-targets-for-optimus-humanoid-robot/), but scaling is projected for 2026-2027; one report notes abandoned 5k target ([Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/investing/comments/1o1y1i9/tesla_abandons_2025_optimus_production_target_of/)). Industrial robot installations grow modestly to ~575k globally in 2025 ([IFR](https://ifr.org/ifr-press-releases/news/global-robot-demand-in-factories-doubles-over-10-years)), not revolutionary scale. Electricity demand surges are driven by AI data centers (doubling to 945 TWh by 2030 per [IEA](https://www.iea.org/reports/energy-and-ai/energy-demand-from-ai)), not robots. Hype exists ([McKinsey](https://www.mckinsey.com/~/media/mckinsey/email/rethink/2025/09/2025-09-10d.html)), but no materialized impact yet—too early to evaluate.
